svg.desc: The four-session flow a change passes through. A GitHub issue or one-line ask feeds session 1, which writes a plan file; I review the plan, and session 2 implements it into a draft PR; I review the diff, and session 3 addresses the code review, looping back on itself for further rounds; session 4 finalizes, and I squash-merge.

span.p: a GitHub issue, or a one-line ask

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Session 1 — /issue or /plan
a plan file, committed to the branch

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Session 2 — /implement
code, DRY pass, docs pass, draft PR

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Session 3 — /from-branch, address code review
fixes, and a reply on every thread

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Session 4 — /finalize
sweep artifacts, merge main, run the gates
